edits.after: Eventually, others see only that this person's own tasks remain unfinished. They do not see all the gaps the person has been covering to keep the shared work going.
edits.reason: Repair the literal 'holding together the gaps'; the person sustains the work by covering gaps, not by maintaining gaps themselves.
edits.before: Eventually, others see only that the person's own tasks remain unfinished, not that they have been holding together the gaps in shared work all along.

edits.after: “Thank goodness we have you” should not mean “so we never need to address why you're always the only one stepping in.”
edits.reason: Naturalize 'solve why' while preserving the demand to address the underlying recurring dependence.
edits.before: “Thank goodness we have you” should not mean “so we needn't solve why it's always only you.”

edits.after: Stepping in should also include a way to step back out.
edits.reason: Clarify the ending of temporary gap-filling, rather than the abstract 'point toward an eventual withdrawal'.
edits.before: Good gap-filling should point toward an eventual withdrawal.

edits.after: Al final, los demás solo ven que no ha terminado sus propias tareas, sin ver todos los huecos que ha cubierto para que el trabajo común siga adelante.
edits.reason: Repair 'sosteniendo las grietas': the person covers gaps to sustain shared work, not sustain the cracks themselves.
edits.before: Al final, los demás solo ven que no ha terminado sus propias tareas, sin ver que ha estado sosteniendo las grietas del trabajo común.

edits.after: Cubrir bien un hueco también exige prever cómo terminará esa intervención temporal.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'una dirección de salida' and preserve an endpoint for temporary help rather than a boundless new role.
edits.before: Cubrir bien un hueco debe incluir una dirección de salida.

edits.after: Un integrante maduro valora si el asunto es urgente, si él es la persona más adecuada para resolverlo y quién sufrirá qué consecuencias si nadie lo atiende. A veces, efectivamente, debe cubrir primero el hueco y discutir después el problema de organización.
edits.reason: Resolve the ungrammatical/ambiguous 'qué consecuencias tendrá para quién no hacerlo'; preserve urgency, suitability, consequences and sometimes acting first.
edits.before: Un integrante maduro valora si el asunto es urgente, si él es la persona más adecuada para resolverlo y qué consecuencias tendrá para quién no hacerlo. A veces, efectivamente, debe cubrir primero el hueco y discutir después el problema de organización.

edits.after: Being good at coordination should not mean having to do only coordination forever. Having patiently helped others should not cost someone opportunities to focus on their own direction. Recognizing an ability should give the person more choice and the conditions to use it, not permanently lock them into the role most convenient for the organization.
edits.reason: Choice and supporting conditions belong to the person exercising the ability, not the ability treated as an agent.
edits.before: Being good at coordination should not mean having to do only coordination forever. Having patiently helped others should not cost someone opportunities to focus on their own direction. Recognizing an ability should give it choice and supporting conditions, not permanently lock someone into the role most convenient for the organization.

edits.after: Not by turning every act of goodwill into a job duty, but by ensuring that a few people no longer have to pay quietly—with their own time, emotional energy, and boundaries—for the contributions that keep everyone's work going.
edits.reason: Naturalize the final metaphor while preserving the critique of forced formalization and all three personal costs.
edits.before: Not by absorbing all goodwill into formal roles, but by ensuring that the contributions sustaining everyone's work no longer have to be quietly paid for by a few people's time, emotions, and boundaries.

edits.after: En otros trabajos, en cambio, cuando todo sale bien parece que no ha ocurrido nada.
edits.reason: Repair the unnatural 'el mejor resultado parece que no haya ocurrido nada'; preserve invisible successful prevention.
edits.before: En otros trabajos, en cambio, el mejor resultado parece que no haya ocurrido nada.

edits.after: Hacer visible ese trabajo tampoco puede convertirse en otra forma de encasillar a quien lo hace.
edits.reason: 'Una nueva fijación' can mean a psychological fixation; the source means fixing people permanently into a role.
edits.before: Hacer visible tampoco puede convertirse en una nueva fijación.

edits.after: Que a alguien se le dé bien coordinar no debería condenarlo a hacer solo eso desde entonces; haber ayudado con paciencia no debería quitarle la oportunidad de concentrarse en su propio camino. Reconocer una capacidad sirve para ampliar las opciones de quien la tiene y darle las condiciones para ejercerla, no para encerrarlo permanentemente en el papel más cómodo para la organización.
edits.reason: Make the person's choice and conditions explicit, rather than ascribe options to an abstract capacity. Retain both examples and the anti-lock-in conclusion.
edits.before: Que a alguien se le dé bien coordinar no debería condenarlo a hacer solo eso desde entonces; haber ayudado con paciencia no debería quitarle la oportunidad de concentrarse en su propio camino. Reconocer una capacidad sirve para darle opciones y condiciones, no para encerrar a una persona permanentemente en el papel más cómodo para la organización.

edits.after: But being the last person to handle a result does not mean having control over everything that shaped it.
edits.reason: Naturalize possession of all conditions as control over relevant conditions, preserving the non-automatic attribution of responsibility.
edits.before: But being the last person through whose hands a result passed does not necessarily mean possessing all the conditions that determined it.

edits.after: Who designed the process they used? Who set the deadline? Was the information complete? Had warnings already appeared upstream? Did they have authority to pause, redo, or refuse to continue? Had the organization long been rewarding speed instead of protecting quality?
edits.reason: Remove the confusing nested 'substituted rewards for speed for safeguards for quality'; retain every causal inquiry.
edits.before: Who designed the process they used? Who set the deadline? Was the information complete? Had warnings already appeared upstream? Did they have authority to pause, redo, or refuse to continue? Had the organization long substituted rewards for speed for safeguards for quality?

edits.after: Finding the person nearest the outcome does not tell us where change would make the biggest difference next time.
edits.reason: Make the point-of-intervention argument natural rather than treat an abstract point as an actor able to change results.
edits.before: Finding the nearest person is not the same as finding the point best able to change the next outcome.

edits.after: But if someone must continually sacrifice time, bypass processes, or rely on individual heroics to compensate for constraints built up by decisions above them, responsibility no longer lies only in the final step.
edits.reason: Clarify the accumulated upstream decisions and constraints without removing any of the three costly compensations.
edits.before: But if someone must continually sacrifice time, bypass processes, or rely on individual heroics to compensate for conditions accumulated above them, responsibility no longer lies only in the final step.

edits.after: Someone saying “this is my responsibility” does not necessarily mean other decision-makers have none. The organization should distinguish that person's willingness to step forward from a finding that they alone caused the entire outcome. It must not let the real chain of decisions disappear again just because someone is willing to stand up.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'a complete factual attribution' while retaining the distinction between volunteered responsibility and full factual causation.
edits.before: Someone saying “this is my responsibility” does not necessarily mean other decision-makers no longer bear responsibility. An organization should distinguish that person's willingness to step forward from a complete factual attribution, rather than letting the real chain of decisions disappear again because someone is willing to stand up.

edits.after: Puede haber responsabilidades claras, ajustes necesarios y cambios de papel. Pero un error debe entenderse primero como una acción que necesita explicación, no como una prueba definitiva de que, en adelante, esa persona ya no merece confianza.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'como toda la prueba' while preserving actual consequences and rejecting total future character judgment from one error.
edits.before: Puede haber responsabilidades claras, ajustes necesarios y cambios de papel. Pero un error debe entenderse primero como una acción que necesita explicación, no como toda la prueba de que, desde ese momento, una persona no merece confianza.

edits.after: Que alguien diga «es mi responsabilidad» no significa necesariamente que los demás responsables de decisiones hayan dejado de tenerla. La organización debe distinguir entre su disposición a dar la cara y la conclusión de que esa persona causó por sí sola todo el resultado, en vez de permitir que la verdadera cadena de decisiones vuelva a ocultarse porque alguien se ha ofrecido a responder.
edits.reason: Make factual full attribution clear rather than the opaque 'atribución completa de los hechos'; preserve other decision-makers and the visible decision chain.
edits.before: Que alguien diga «es mi responsabilidad» no significa necesariamente que los demás responsables de decisiones hayan dejado de tenerla. La organización debe distinguir entre su disposición a responder y la atribución completa de los hechos, en vez de permitir que la verdadera cadena de decisiones vuelva a ocultarse porque alguien se ha ofrecido a dar la cara.

edits.after: But it can also lead the organization to treat every moment without visible output as unused capacity.
edits.reason: Lack of immediately visible output is not already unproductive time; preserve the critical distinction demonstrated by thinking, recovery and helping in the next paragraph.
edits.before: But it can also interpret all temporarily unproductive time as unused capacity.

edits.after: An organization introducing a tool well does not ask only, “How much more can everyone do now?”
edits.reason: Naturalize 'a good introduction of tools' and give the following 'It also asks' a clear organizational subject.
edits.before: A good introduction of tools does not ask only, “How much more can everyone do now?”

edits.after: If every achievement in automation brings only a higher target, people learn that speeding the work up will not make their jobs better. It will only be taken as proof that they can do more. They may still use tools but stop actively turning new methods into shared capacity.
edits.reason: Clarify better jobs/working experience rather than ambiguity about improving output quality; retain the conditional claim and reduced sharing.
edits.before: If every achievement in automation brings only a higher target, members learn that making work faster will not improve anyone's work. It will merely prove they can take on more. They may still use tools but stop actively turning new methods into shared capacity.

edits.after: Reducen pasos repetitivos, automatizan partes que antes requerían intervención humana y permiten que una persona complete en poco tiempo una carga que antes no podía asumir.
edits.reason: Artificial/manual contrast refers to human work generally, not only physical manual labor; retain the individual increase in capacity.
edits.before: Reducen pasos repetitivos, automatizan partes que antes exigían tiempo de trabajo manual y permiten que una persona complete en poco tiempo una carga que antes no podía asumir.

edits.after: Pero también puede hacer que todo intervalo sin resultados visibles se interprete como tiempo todavía no utilizado.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'sin resultados momentáneos' and preserve the difference between visibility and actual useful activity.
edits.before: Pero también puede interpretar todo tiempo sin resultados momentáneos como tiempo todavía no utilizado.

edits.after: Being irreplaceable points to rare abilities and shows how deeply the organization depends on that person.
edits.reason: Clarify scarcity as rare capacities, not someone having few or insufficient abilities.
edits.before: Being irreplaceable shows that someone's abilities are scarce and that the organization depends deeply on them.

edits.after: If recognition goes only to those who personally solve the most problems, members will naturally keep the difficult cases for themselves. If training a successor means their previous contributions are then considered unnecessary, anyone will fear that sharing knowledge reduces their own value.
edits.reason: 'Keep problems to themselves' can mean hide unreported problems; source concerns retaining difficult work to preserve personal indispensability.
edits.before: If recognition goes only to those who personally solve the most problems, members will naturally keep difficult problems to themselves. If training a successor means their previous contributions are then considered unnecessary, anyone will fear that sharing knowledge reduces their own value.

edits.after: Solo ellas conocen los pasos esenciales, solo ellas pueden resolver cierto tipo de problemas y solo ellas mantienen algunas relaciones clave. Cada vez que aparece una crisis, todos dicen: «Menos mal que sigue estando».
edits.reason: Replace the redundant 'mantienen el contacto con algunas relaciones importantes' while retaining all three dependencies.
edits.before: Solo ellas conocen los pasos esenciales, solo ellas pueden resolver cierto tipo de problemas y solo ellas mantienen el contacto con algunas relaciones importantes. Cada vez que aparece una crisis, todos dicen: «Menos mal que sigue estando».

edits.after: Que alguien sea insustituible indica que posee capacidades poco comunes y que la organización depende profundamente de él.
edits.reason: 'Su capacidad es escasa' can mean low ability; the source means rare abilities in limited supply.
edits.before: Que alguien sea insustituible indica que su capacidad es escasa y que la organización depende profundamente de él.

edits.after: El individuo también puede encontrar seguridad en ser insustituible. Tener conocimientos exclusivos hace más difícil que se elimine su posición; que otros le pidan ayuda constantemente le confirma su valor. Así, puede resistirse tanto a realizar un traspaso completo como a que los demás juzguen de manera independiente, y acostumbrarse a tomar rápidamente el control ante cada problema.
edits.reason: Repair the ambiguous coordination of resistirse/acostumbrarse while preserving security, knowledge, dependence and rapid takeover.
edits.before: El individuo también puede encontrar seguridad en ser insustituible. Tener conocimientos exclusivos hace más difícil que se elimine su posición; que otros le pidan ayuda constantemente le confirma su valor. Así, puede resistirse a realizar un traspaso completo, a que los demás juzguen de manera independiente y acostumbrarse a tomar rápidamente el control ante cada problema.

edits.after: Si solo se reconoce a quien resuelve personalmente más problemas, los integrantes se reservarán naturalmente los asuntos difíciles; si, después de formar a un sucesor, se considera que la aportación anterior ya no hace falta, cualquiera temerá que compartir conocimientos equivalga a reducir su propio valor.
edits.reason: Clarify retaining difficult tasks for oneself rather than the potentially misleading 'retendrán asuntos difíciles'; preserve the successor-recognition incentive.
edits.before: Si solo se reconoce a quien resuelve personalmente más problemas, los integrantes retendrán naturalmente los asuntos difíciles; si, después de formar a un sucesor, se considera que la aportación anterior ya no hace falta, cualquiera temerá que compartir conocimientos equivalga a reducir su propio valor.

This does not diminish loyalty; it protects its voluntary character. People should want to stay because they still agree with the direction and wish to participate, not because everyone has tied a future they cannot bear onto them.
edits.after: This does not diminish loyalty; it protects its voluntary character. People should want to stay because they still believe in the direction and want to take part—not because everyone else has made them responsible for a future that is too much for them to carry.
edits.reason: Root final English read, with language reviewer confirmation: naturalize the literal tied-a-future-onto-them construction. Meaning, voluntary loyalty and the full argument remain unchanged; this is English copyediting, not a source-level correction.

review_scope.reading_basis: Read every paragraph and title of the formal ZIP Chinese, English and Spanish manuscripts for work26–30 in bounded untruncated outputs. Total726 body-paragraph readings. No unread paragraphs; alignment/Markdown correspondence checked by intake helper.
review_scope.semantic_review: Full argument/example/qualification comparison. Retained temporary gap-filling and its endpoint; urgent help before later system review; invisible contributions without compulsory formalization or equal-task allocation; meaningful chosen care; full decision-chain accountability without automatic executor immunity; capacity gains versus new cognitive work; organizational and individual transition responsibilities; rare excellence without permanent indispensability; portable shared knowledge, dignified exit and non-disposability. All paragraph positions and examples preserved.
review_scope.local_scope: Localized natural-language and precision repairs. Examples include sustaining work by filling gaps rather than sustaining gaps; keeping difficult cases for oneself rather than concealing unreported problems; rare skills rather than low ability; and time without visible output rather than necessarily unproductive time. No Chinese source-level revision found necessary.
review_scope.metadata: Five English titles remove numeric prefixes and are polished where needed. Spanish titles are already natural and unnumbered.
review_scope.limits: Normative editorial/fidelity review, not exhaustive external legal, medical or empirical factchecking. No added external facts, translation service, supplied HTML execution, ZIP/repo changes, integration, visual QA, commit or publication.

root_final_copyedit: Work30 paragraph39: root reviewed the full English essay and accepted the language reviewer’s natural phrasing; no source change.
